name: Fleury Michon SA
summary: Fleury Michon SA produces and sells food products in France and internationally. It offers cold meats, ready meals, fresh surimi, chicken breast, ham and other cured meats, turkey breast, hot snack, spreads/pate, ingredients for cooking, pan-fried meat, raw ham and other cured meats, and roasted and cooked meat. The company offers its products through stores. Fleury Michon SA was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in La Meilleraie-Tillay, France.
